name: solladal
description: சொல்லாடல் (Solladal) — Tamil Word Game for Android & iOS

scripts.prep:mobile: node -e "const {cpSync,rmSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs');rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true});mkdirSync('www');for(const p of ['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js','css','js','data','assets']) cpSync(p,'www/'+p,{recursive:true});console.log('Staged runtime assets into ./www successfully.');"
scripts.build:android: npm run prep:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: npm run prep:mobile && npx cap sync ios

author: deetech.org
